name: video-translator
description: Translate a short-form voiceover video into other languages with your ElevenLabs voice, re-timing the clips so every cut still lands on its word.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: From elevenlabs.io → Developers → API keys. Stored in your system keychain.

voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID
voice_id.description: The voice to speak the translations (Voices → your voice → ID).

jobs_dir.title: Jobs folder
jobs_dir.description: Folder with one subfolder per video (the video + script.txt). Results go inside each subfolder.
